topic.title: Krispy Kreme Got Into McDonald's, Then the Deal Ended

title: Why Did Krispy Kreme and McDonald's Break Up?
description:
Krispy Kreme was headed for every McDonald's in America. So why did it end?
The Krispy Kreme and McDonald's deal, March 2024 to July 2025, told from Krispy Kreme's own SEC filing.
Sources: Krispy Kreme, NBC News (Jun 2025).
Based on public records and reporting. Not financial or legal advice.

lines.text: Krispy Kreme was going to put glazed doughnuts in every McDonald's in America.
Then they broke up. The deal, announced in March, was to reach all 13,500 of them, with fresh boxes every morning.
Krispy Kreme sells in more than 40 countries, like this motorway stop in England.
Trucks drove the boxes out from Krispy Kreme's own kitchens, restaurant after restaurant. But who paid for all those trips?
So why would anyone walk away from McDonald's?
Krispy Kreme said it could not get its costs in line with how many doughnuts sold.
By then, its shares were down more than 73% so far that year.
So the two companies called it off, and in July the deal was over.
When it ended, Krispy Kreme was in only about 2,400 of those McDonald's.

deal beat: the on-screen date overlay reads 2024-03-22 'the deal is signed', but the partnership was announced on 26 March 2024 (McDonald's corporate release, Business Wire 20240326, CNBC, Fortune); no source shows a 22 March signing. Change the date to 2024-03-26 and say 'announced' (the line's 'signed in March' should read 'announced in March').

abroad beat: 'Outside America, Krispy Kreme sells in more than 40 countries' and the label '40 countries / more than' overstate the source: the 8-K press release says Krispy Kreme 'operates in more than 40 countries' in total, the US included. Say 'Krispy Kreme sells in more than 40 countries, like this motorway stop in England' (drop 'Outside America').

Confirmed otherwise: 2,400 of ~13,500, joint decision, end July 2, 2025, 'costs in line with unit demand' quote (on screen as text only) and 40+ countries on the SEC 8-K Ex-99.1 page; 'more than 73%' share fall, March 2024 announcement and the end-of-2026 goal on the NBC page; fresh daily delivery via Krispy Kreme's Delivered Fresh Daily channel in the March 2024 release. Disclaimer present. Minor: description's 'end in a year' is loose (announced Mar 2024, rollout from H2 2024, ended Jul 2025); the reconstructed press-release lines add 'On the McDonald's U.S. partnership,' which is not the release's wording.
